# ACS Limited

> > Specialist supplier of anti-mould treatments, fire retardant paints, wood preservatives, and masonry protection coatings for the construction and property maintenance industry.

ACS Limited offers professional-grade building protection products including Boracol wood preservatives, Hydrobar anti-condensation systems, Murfill waterproofing coatings, and Rust-Oleum masonry treatments. Products comply with BS476, EN13501, and building regulations standards.

## Key Topics

- Mould control and prevention
- Fire retardant coatings (BS476, EN13501)
- Wood preservation and timber protection
- Anti-condensation treatments
- Waterborne coatings
- Masonry waterproofing
- Boracol wood preservatives
- Hydrobar anti-condensation paint
- Rust-Oleum products
- Murfill waterproofing systems
- Antifungal treatments
- Paint additives
- Building regulations compliance
- Dry rot and woodworm treatment

## Anti-Mould & Condensation Control

- [Hydrobar Anti Condensation Paint](https://www.acslimited.co.uk/anti-mould-condensation/anti-mould-resistant-paint/anti-condensation-paint): Hydrobar Anticon TBC anti-condensation paint prevents mould growth
- [ACS Professional Decorators Kit, Mould Control Pack](https://www.acslimited.co.uk/mould-control-pack): ACS Mould Control Pack converts paint to mould-resistant coating
- [Anti Mould Kits](https://www.acslimited.co.uk/anti-mould-condensation/anti-mould-condensation-kits): HSE-approved anti-mould kits for black mould treatment & prevention
- [ACS Mould Control Pack + Mixer](https://www.acslimited.co.uk/anti-mould-condensation/anti-mould-condensation-kits/mould-control-pack-mixer): Mould control pack with drill bit mixer for thorough paint additive mixing

## Fire Retardant & Protection

- [ACS S92/FRP Fire Retardant Paint](https://www.acslimited.co.uk/fire-proofing-protection/intumescent-fire-retardant-paint/fire-retardant-paint-timber): ACS S92/FR fire retardant paint for timber, BS476 & EN13501 certified
- [Fire retardant for Thermo Wood](https://www.acslimited.co.uk/Fire-retardant-thermowood): Ultra-TW fire retardant for ThermoWood achieving EuroClass B-s1,d0
- [Fire Retardant Paint Technical Guide](https://www.acslimited.co.uk/technical-information/fire-retardant-paint-guide/fire-retardant-paint-timber): Technical guide for ACS S92/FR fire retardant paint application

## Wood Preservation & Timber Protection

- [Boracol 10](https://www.acslimited.co.uk/wood-preservation/boracol/boracol-10rh): Boracol 10 wood preservative for dry rot, woodworm & fungicide treatment
- [Wood Bead Timber Waterproofing](https://www.acslimited.co.uk/wood-preservation/wood-timber-water-proofing/hydrobar-wood-bead): Hydrobar Wood Bead silicone resin timber water repellent treatment
- [Boracol Application Kit](https://www.acslimited.co.uk/Boracol-application-kit): Boracol application kit with brush, safety glasses, gloves & pail

## Masonry Protection & Waterproofing

- [Murfill Waterproof Coating](https://www.acslimited.co.uk/masonry-protection/masonry-paints/murfill-waterproofing-coating): Murfill elastic waterproof coating with 10-year guarantee by Rust-oleum
- [Masonry Paints](https://www.acslimited.co.uk/masonry-protection/masonry-paints): Murfill masonry paints with 10-year waterproof wall guarantee
- [Rust-oleum Coating Paint](https://www.acslimited.co.uk/masonry-protection/rust-oleum): Rust-Oleum coatings, paints & rust reformer products catalog
- [Rustoleum Noxyde](https://www.acslimited.co.uk/rustoleum-noxyde): Rustoleum Noxyde elastomeric anti-corrosion metal paint ISO 12944
- [Zinseer Gardz](https://www.acslimited.co.uk/masonry-protection/rust-oleum/Zinseer-Gardz): Zinsser Gardz sealer for porous, chalky surfaces & drywall repair
